components.name: Solid Hardware Leaf
components.description: A leaf block with no visible children; the tall TL-UL Crossbar uses this same solid treatment.
components.css: .ds-leaf { position:relative; width:220px; min-height:125px; display:grid; grid-template-rows:6px 1fr; overflow:hidden; padding:0; border:2px solid #101c26; border-radius:5px; background:#101c26; color:#fff; box-shadow:0 10px 24px rgba(24,48,63,.18); text-align:left; } .ds-leaf-accent { background:#087f8c; } .ds-leaf-body { position:relative; display:block; height:100%; padding:2px 10px 10px; overflow:hidden; } .ds-leaf strong { display:block; overflow:hidden; font:800 13px/1.05 'Coral Ubuntu Sans',sans-serif; text-overflow:ellipsis; text-transform:uppercase; white-space:nowrap; } .ds-leaf small { position:absolute; right:10px; bottom:8px; left:10px; overflow:hidden; color:#c8d4da; font-size:8px; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:.08em; text-overflow:ellipsis; text-transform:uppercase; white-space:nowrap; } .ds-port { position:absolute; right:3px; top:50%; max-width:74px; padding:3px 4px; border-radius:2px; background:#9aabb5; font:800 7px/1 SFMono-Regular,monospace; transform:translateY(-50%); }

components.description: An unfilled heavy outline with an explicit Open action, authored child positions, and visible internal protocol routing.

components.css: .ds-composite { padding:9px; border:4px solid #101c26; border-radius:5px; background:#f7f9fa; color:#101c26; box-shadow:0 10px 24px rgba(24,48,63,.18); } .ds-composite header { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; padding:0 7px 8px; border-bottom:3px solid #101c26; } .ds-composite header span { display:grid; } .ds-composite header strong { font:800 17px/1 'Coral Ubuntu Sans',sans-serif; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-composite header small { margin-top:4px; color:#596b77; font-size:9px; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:.08em; } .ds-composite header button { border:1px solid #91a2ad; border-radius:3px; background:transparent; font-size:9px; font-weight:800; } .ds-internal { position:relative; height:130px; margin-top:7px; } .ds-internal svg { position:absolute; inset:0; width:100%; height:100%; } .ds-internal path { fill:none; stroke:#55a63f; stroke-width:3; } .ds-child { position:absolute; padding:10px 8px; border-top:5px solid #55a63f; border-radius:3px; background:#101c26; color:#fff; font-size:10px; font-weight:800; } .ds-child.a { left:8px; top:10px; } .ds-child.b { right:8px; bottom:8px; }

components.name: Coral SoC Boundary
components.description: The heavy labeled enclosure around all non-external blocks in the active SoC focus.
components.css: .ds-boundary { position:relative; min-height:220px; border:5px solid #101c26; border-radius:7px; background:transparent; } .ds-boundary > span { position:absolute; top:-32px; left:-5px; padding:5px 10px 6px; border-radius:4px 4px 0 0; background:#101c26; color:#fff; font:800 13px 'Coral Ubuntu Sans',sans-serif; letter-spacing:.04em; text-transform:uppercase; }

components.name: External HyperRAM Leaf
components.description: The only orange hardware module, positioned outside the Coral SoC enclosure.

components.css: .ds-port-host { position:relative; width:230px; min-height:110px; display:grid; place-items:center; overflow:hidden; border:2px solid #101c26; border-radius:5px; background:#101c26; color:#fff; } .ds-port { position:absolute; max-width:74px; padding:3px 4px; overflow:hidden; border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.72); border-radius:2px; background:#55a63f; color:#fff; font:800 7px/1 SFMono-Regular,monospace; letter-spacing:.015em; text-overflow:ellipsis; text-transform:uppercase; white-space:nowrap; } .ds-port-left { left:3px; top:50%; transform:translateY(-50%); } .ds-port-right { right:3px; top:50%; transform:translateY(-50%); }

components.name: Compact Nested Node
components.description: A dense internal block with reserved port side zones and a separate centered name zone; no kind or route text competes for space.
components.css: .ds-compact { position:relative; width:170px; height:105px; overflow:hidden; padding:0; border:1px solid #101c26; border-top:5px solid #d97706; border-radius:3px; background:#101c26; color:#fff; } .ds-compact strong { position:absolute; top:50%; right:37%; left:37%; max-height:2.1em; overflow:hidden; font:800 8px/1.05 'Coral Ubuntu Sans',sans-serif; text-align:center; text-overflow:ellipsis; text-transform:uppercase; transform:translateY(-50%); } .ds-cport { position:absolute; top:50%; max-width:36%; padding:1px 2px; overflow:hidden; border-radius:2px; background:#55a63f; font:800 4.5px/1 SFMono-Regular,monospace; text-overflow:ellipsis; text-transform:uppercase; white-space:nowrap; transform:translateY(-50%); } .ds-cport.left { left:3px; } .ds-cport.right { right:3px; }

components.css: .ds-boot { display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr auto; gap:8px 18px; min-height:108px; padding:13px 15px 11px; border:1px solid #314451; border-radius:10px; background:rgba(16,28,38,.96); box-shadow:0 16px 34px rgba(16,28,38,.22); color:#fff; } .ds-boot small { color:#c8d4da; font:800 9px SFMono-Regular,monospace; letter-spacing:.05em; } .ds-boot h2 { margin:4px 0; font:800 18px/1 'Coral Ubuntu Sans',sans-serif; } .ds-boot p { margin:0; color:#d8e2e7; font-size:10px; } .ds-boot nav { align-self:center; display:flex; } .ds-boot button { min-height:38px; border:1px solid #536774; background:transparent; color:#fff; } .ds-progress { grid-column:1/-1; display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(8,1fr); gap:4px; } .ds-progress i { height:3px; background:#536774; } .ds-progress .done { background:#55a63f; } .ds-progress .current { height:7px; background:#fff; }

components.name: Evidence Resource Link
components.description: A precise document, issue, or RTL reference in the selected-block inspector.
components.css: .ds-resource { min-height:48px; display:grid; grid-template-columns:30px 1fr auto; align-items:center; gap:9px; padding:7px 9px; border:1px solid #c5d0d6; border-radius:11px; background:#f7f9fa; color:#101c26; text-decoration:none; } .ds-resource-icon { width:30px; height:30px; display:grid; place-items:center; border-radius:8px; background:#dde5e8; } .ds-resource strong,.ds-resource small { display:block; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap; } .ds-resource strong { font-size:11px; } .ds-resource small { margin-top:2px; color:#596b77; font:9px SFMono-Regular,monospace; }

narrative.overview: A bright lab drafting table turns the original box diagram into a connected, inspectable architecture panorama. Fixed node rectangles and port anchors are authored in architecture/soc.yaml; the interface never auto-places them. Heavy unfilled containers expose immediate blocks and internal routes; only leaves are solid. Small port-role badges sit inside block edges and carry interface meaning, so routes omit text. Leaf titles and kinds occupy separate bands; compact nodes reserve side zones for ports and a centered name zone. Visible text never intersects.
keyCharacteristics: Bright dotted drafting canvas with a pannable, zoomable panorama.
Unfilled heavy-outline hierarchy containers around solid leaf modules.
Tall solid TL-UL Crossbar as the interconnect spine.
Authored fixed-position canvases with no automatic placement.
Explicit protocol-colored MASTER/SLAVE, HOST/DEVICE, bus, fabric, and control port badges.
Unlabeled routes decoded by endpoint badges and the protocol legend.
Collision-free title, kind, centered-name, and port zones.
Visible internal protocol routing inside composite previews.
Explicit Open, Up, and breadcrumb hierarchy navigation.
Boot playback over the authored diagram with reduced-motion-safe behavior.
Orange external HyperRAM outside the Coral SoC enclosure.
Protocol-colored orthogonal routes with labels and a persistent legend.
Readable mobile and VS Code canvas-plus-inspector behavior.

rules.name: The Protocol Is Data Rule
rules.body: Never recolor AXI, TL-UL, DBUS, IBUS, EBUS, or Fabric for decoration; repeat meaning in labels and the legend.

rules.name: The Orange Is Outside Rule
rules.body: Orange identifies external HyperRAM, not a general action accent.

rules.name: The Schematic Label Rule
rules.body: Hardware names and kinds are terse, uppercase, and heavier than metadata.

rules.name: The No-Collision Rule
rules.body: Every visible string owns a reserved zone; text may auto-fit or truncate but must never intersect another label, badge, border, or route.

rules.name: The Containment Before Elevation Rule
rules.body: Use heavy outlines and exposed children to communicate hierarchy; never replace nesting with fill or a larger shadow.

dos: Do preserve the unfilled-container and solid-leaf hierarchy at every nesting level.
Do treat authored canvas rectangles and port anchors as visual source of truth.
Do show exact port roles inset inside their authored boundary offsets.
Do omit route text and use endpoint badges plus the legend for interface meaning.
Do reserve separate text and port zones; auto-fit leaf titles only to the 8px floor.
Do show internal routes behind children in composite previews.
Do preserve Open, Up, and breadcrumb hierarchy navigation.
Do keep Boot playback on the structural diagram and disable autoplay for reduced motion.
Do keep the tall TL-UL Crossbar solid because it is a leaf.
Do keep HyperRAM orange and outside the heavy Coral SoC enclosure.
Do preserve exact protocol color names, endpoint port-role labels, and legend keys.
Do retain pan, zoom, fit, and readable stacked evidence behavior on mobile and in VS Code.
donts: Don't solid-fill SoC, DMA, Coral Core, or any composite block.
Don't introduce automatic placement, rank-based reflow, or inferred port positions.
Don't replace MASTER/SLAVE or HOST/DEVICE with vague protocol-only badges.
Don't place port badges outside their block boundaries.
Don't draw text on routes or let any visible strings intersect.
Don't wrap leaf titles or shrink them below 8px.
Don't hide internal connection routes in composite previews.
Don't replace Boot playback with a separate timeline or autoplay it for reduced-motion users.
Don't turn the architecture into a generic card grid, bubble graph, or rounded SaaS dashboard.
Don't use protocol colors decoratively or remap them for state.
Don't hide unknown ownership, missing evidence, or unconfirmed RTL.
Don't shrink the mobile panorama until labels and hierarchy become unreadable.
